## What's Changed
### Features
* feat(ruby): map core errors to typed exception classes by @ya-luotao in https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/pull/1455
* feat(sdk): rename allow_passthrough_for to allow_placeholder_for by @toksdotdev in https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/pull/1667
### Fixes
* fix(release): order versioned dev dependencies before publication by @toksdotdev in https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/pull/1653
* fix(ruby): refresh standalone Cargo.lock and check the crates.io pin by @ya-luotao in https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/pull/1456
* fix(network): scope secret scanning to request locations by @toksdotdev in https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/pull/1666
* fix(filesystem): keep surviving macos hard links writable by @toksdotdev in https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/pull/1668
### CI
* ci(release): categorize notes and filter mintlify noise by @toksdotdev in https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/pull/1659
### Maintenance
* chore: refresh npm lockfile after v0.7.3 by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/pull/1652
* chore(release): bump all packages to 0.7.4 by @toksdotdev in https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/pull/1665


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/compare/v0.7.3...v0.7.4
